title: Sword & Sorcery
overview:
I'll protect you, even though I don't know you. So... let's save everyone together!

- 3D polygons + texture mapping
- Fight in 3D battle areas!
- Speech-bubble character message windows
- Original animation
- S&S Fantastic Symphony, Second Movement

Lucienne, a young girl looking after her master's tower while he is away, meets Ago, a man cursed to turn into a wolf who has come seeking the master's help. Together they set out to find a cure, traveling from town to town, helping the people they meet with their troubles and gaining new companions along the way.

Explore towns, dungeons and the world map, take on requests and buy equipment, and smash objects to open new paths or uncover items. Turn-based battles play out on 3D battlefields where obstacles can block attacks. The cycle of day and night decides whether Ago fights as a man or as a wolf.

知らない君を守ってあげる。
だから・・一緒にみんなを救おっ！

- ３Ｄポリゴン+テクスチャーマッピング
- ３Ｄバトルエリアで戦え！
- フキダシ式キャラメッセージウインドウ
- オリジナルアニメーション
- Ｓ＆Ｓファンタジックシンフォニー第２楽章
